title: CareWorkspace
description: An async-first virtual care platform designed to eliminate bottlenecked live-video queues by triaging patient requests through deterministic safety gates. Cases are routed into live consultations, pending document holds, or async-ready queues where Google Gemini synthesizes patient intake into structured decision briefs. Clinicians can safely review grouped cases and attest to close care episodes in under a minute while maintaining full medical oversight.
